say:2:1631928002:1.text: My goal now is to become the most outstanding of all ghosts.
say:2:1631928002:1.source_cn: 我现在的目标就是成为幽灵里最杰出的存在。
say:2:1631928002:1.male: My goal now is to become the most outstanding of all ghosts.
say:2:1631928002:1.female: My goal now is to become the most outstanding of all ghosts.

say:3:1631928003:1.text: When I achieve that, my name will be remembered forever.
say:3:1631928003:1.source_cn: 当我足够优秀的时候，哪怕是作为幽灵，也可以千古留名。
say:3:1631928003:1.male: When I achieve that, my name will be remembered forever.
say:3:1631928003:1.female: When I achieve that, my name will be remembered forever.

say:4:1631928004:1.text: As long as my mind still works, I must have a purpose.
say:4:1631928004:1.source_cn: 无论如何，只要还可以思考，就要有目标。
say:4:1631928004:1.male: As long as my mind still works, I must have a purpose.
say:4:1631928004:1.female: As long as my mind still works, I must have a purpose.

say:6:1631928005:1.text: I did feel stressed from time to time when I was alive, but things have gotten much easier since I became a ghost.
say:6:1631928005:1.source_cn: 活着的时候偶尔焦虑，成为幽灵后确实短暂地不焦虑了。
say:6:1631928005:1.male: I did feel stressed from time to time when I was alive, but things have gotten much easier since I became a ghost.
say:6:1631928005:1.female: I did feel stressed from time to time when I was alive, but things have gotten much easier since I became a ghost.

say:7:1631928006:1.text: I have unlimited time to spend now.
say:7:1631928006:1.source_cn: 但一想到我还有那么长的时间可以浪费。
say:7:1631928006:1.male: I have unlimited time to spend now.
say:7:1631928006:1.female: I have unlimited time to spend now.

say:8:1631928007:1.text: And all that does is leave me feeling empty! I'd rather have something to work toward than be tortured by that.
say:8:1631928007:1.source_cn: 我就觉得非常空虚！比起那折磨人的空虚，我更愿意自己被一...
say:8:1631928007:1.male: And all that does is leave me feeling empty! I'd rather have something to work toward than be tortured by that.
say:8:1631928007:1.female: And all that does is leave me feeling empty! I'd rather have something to work toward than be tortured by that.

say:9:1631928008:1.text: Guess that's the point of working hard.
say:9:1631928008:1.source_cn: 我想这就是努力的意义。
